messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — high error rate detected for org=KestrelApps (us-west-2)
incident-bot: metric: 429_rate=52% over 1m window on /v1/generate, p95 latency unchanged, throughput up 3.2x, triggered at 2026-03-15T08:07:14Z
alice: I'm on it. paging @ben for infra / routing checks. did we hit capacity or is this per-org throttling?
ben: looking at cluster. host CPU ok, GPU utilization normal. lots of small short requests from customers/KestrelApps token. appears they're sending a burst of small requests and hitting per-org token bucket limits, yielding 429s.
carla: KestrelApps SE pinged support — they're seeing failed requests and loss of availability for a critical batch job. They asked if we can raise quota while they throttle upstream.
dinesh: KestrelApps confirms they kicked off an emergency job accidentally. They can back off but need a short window to finish. asking for a temporary allowance.
alice: options: 1) Temporarily bump KestrelApps org rate limit (hotfix) 2) Route their traffic to a dedicated higher-rate pool if we can spin one fast 3) Apply targeted traffic-shaping to reduce retries. fastest is a per-org rate bump.
evans: routing change is ~15m to provision. per-org bump via admin is ~30s. recommend bump + throttle guidance.
frank: agree. do a conservative bump: current org burst=3000 rps -> 8000 rps for 10 minutes, with automatic rollback. add logging and abort if overall cluster 429s spike.
alice: I'll run the hotfix. runbook: ops/runbooks/org-rate-adjust.md. command I'll use:

```
redwoodctl org adjust-rate --org KestrelApps --rps 8000 --burst 12000 --duration 10m --note "emergency: customer accidental spike; monitored rollback"
```

alice: executing now. monitoring metrics in #eng-runtime and CloudWatch.
alice: <@carla> can you confirm the customer understands this is temporary? please send a short note to their SE.
carla: will do. emailing now: "We've enabled a 10m emergency burst window while you wind down the job. Please confirm when you stop sending the batch."
grace: logging a support ticket (SUP-8731) linking incident.
ben: watching cluster-level 429s and queueing. so far no other org degradation. p50 latency rising slightly (+30ms) but within SLO.
incident-bot: ACTION: rate-adjust applied by alice (hotfix-id=hotfix-1775001234-kestrel) — scheduled rollback at 2026-03-15T08:17:14Z
dinesh: KestrelApps reports success, job finishing. reducing retries on their side now.
frank: enabling verbose request logs for KestrelApps token to capture noisy clients (for postmortem) — retention 24h.
alice: moving to monitoring; I'll handoff to ben for the next 30m observation window. ben — take it.
ben: taking the handoff. I'm setting alerts: if cluster 429_rate > 5% OR cluster error increase then notify @oncall immediately. also I'll patch the rollback window to automatic + manual override. CLI I used:

```
redwoodctl alert create --name "kestrel-org-fallback" --expr "cluster_429_rate > 0.05" --notify #oncall
```

ben: also added a temporary quota rule so this org can't request more than 20k tokens/min after the window; defensive cap.
carla: customer acknowledged and said they will throttle within 5m. thanks team.
incident-bot: NOTE: update runbook entry with hotfix-id and customer contact: hotfix-1775001234-kestrel
alice: rollback triggered automatically at scheduled time. removing hotfix now.
alice: command used to remove:

```
redwoodctl org revert-rate --org KestrelApps --hotfix hotfix-1775001234-kestrel
```

alice: rollback complete. cluster 429s remain low. p95 latency baseline.
ben: I'll keep the temporary alert on for another 20m, then close. opening a postmortem ticket to capture why customer job exploded and to add a preflight for org-level big jobs.
frank: note: we should add an automated customer-contact playbook to ask for explicit approval for >X rps bursts going forward. filing RFC.
carla: following up with KestrelApps AC to recommend rate-limiting client-side and add exponential backoff. copying CS.
grace: Support notes updated (SUP-8731): summary, hotfix id, actions taken, contact logs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — mitigation removed, monitoring in place, postmortem ticket PM-482 opened.
ben: handing back to alice for any final checks.
alice: thanks team. I'm available if the alert fires. closing thread in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
